title: Grateful Pets
description: Feed a pet and it will thank you. Every feed costs one food item and always returns 5 desalination pellets, plus one random gift from a table of nuggets, gemstones, figurines and jewellery. Works on any creature with the Pet or StartingPet tag, or the Pettable part - base game and Pets of Harvest Dawn DLC alike.
author: Christopher Mayfield
